artifact.netlist:
* elec_011 Precision 2.500V reference divider

* Divider: top -> vref -> gnd, sized with 10k load included
R1 top vref 7400

* Supply current = 4e-4*2.5 = 1.0 mA (<= 1.5 mA); Rsense drop = 0.100 V (<= 0.15 V)
.op
.end

* Rd5  = (46.775 - 5)/0.1 = 417.75 ohm
Rd12 remote v12 173.875
Rd5 remote v5 417.75
*
.op
.end
